settings.title: Settings
settings.addApiKeyHint: Add your Anthropic API key to the
settings.additionalProvidersDesc: Configure API keys to use OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Mistral models. Keys are stored in server memory only (runtime).
settings.aiProviderKeysDesc: Paste API keys for Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Mistral. Keys apply immediately (no restart), are stored on this server's database (encrypted at rest when an instance encryption key is configured), and survive restarts. Saved keys are never displayed again.
settings.defaultSettingsDesc: These defaults are applied when opening a new module session.
settings.languageDesc: Choose the interface language. Module content remains in English.
settings.deploymentDesc: Current deployment mode determines available features.
settings.soloModeDesc: Solo mode: Single-user setup. All features available without login. Audit log tracks your personal usage and cost.
settings.teamModeDesc: Team mode: Multi-user setup with full audit trail, user attribution on reviews, and shared session management.
settings.soloModeDescription: Solo mode: Single-user setup. All features available without login. Audit log tracks your personal usage and cost. To enable team features (user attribution, shared review workflows), set DEPLOYMENT_MODE=team in your .env file and restart the server.
settings.teamModeDescription: Team mode: Multi-user setup with full audit trail, user attribution on reviews, and shared session management. Review statuses show who approved each AI output.
settings.budgetDesc: Set a monthly AI spending cap in EUR. When the limit is reached, new requests are blocked. Set to 0 for no limit.
settings.budgetCapReached: Monthly budget cap reached. New AI requests are blocked until next month.
settings.notificationsDesc: Configure email alerts for long-running analyses.
settings.emailNotification: Email me when a long analysis completes
settings.emailNotificationDesc: Receive an email notification when Claude finishes a lengthy task. Requires SMTP to be configured in your .env file.
settings.brandTemplatesDesc: Upload your company's .docx or .pptx templates. Use "Export with Template" in the export bar to inject Claude's output into your branded files.
settings.knowledgeLibraryDesc: Register named document corpora for use across all modules. Index them once, reuse everywhere.
settings.customModelsDesc: Add up to 2 custom models. They appear in the model selector across all modules. Use any model ID from a supported provider.
